sloka: कच्चित् सहस्रान् मूर्खाणामेकमिच्छसि पण्डितम् ।पण्डितो ह्यर्थकृच्छ्रेषु कुर्य्यान्नि:श्रेयसं महत् ॥ २.१००.२३॥
transliteration: kaccit sahasrān mūrkhāṇāmekamicchasi paṇḍitam ।paṇḍito hyarthakṛcchreṣu kuryyānni:śreyasaṁ mahat ॥ 2.100.23॥

translations.english: Even if the king seeks the assistance from thousands or tens of thousands of fools, they cannot render any help to him.
